opening.argument: The video presents a $100 Starbucks gift card as free and directs viewers toward immediate acquisition through an external link. It tells viewers to “submit your email, fill out the survey” and claims the gift card would then arrive at their address, making a valuable reward contingent on low-barrier personal-data and survey actions. The frames reinforce both the unusually attractive offer and the required click. The available evidence does not establish whether the offer was authorized or fulfilled; the basis for this finding is the observed promotion and requested actions.
